title: 4-bit variable-speed down-counter with reset
summary: Demo 1 modified: 4-bit binary down-counter on LED0-LED3. Decrements once per second; three times per second while BTNU is held. Holding BTNC resets the count to 0.

inputs.name: reset_btn
inputs.description: Hold to reset the count to 0

assumptions: Counter starts at 0 after configuration and wraps from 0 to 15 when counting down
BTNU and BTNC are debounced for 10 ms
While BTNC is held the count stays at 0; counting resumes one full period after release
